pr_title: fix: Allow format object series with registry

issue_context.title: Cannot print Series of type Object
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.
- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.

### Reproducible example

```python
import polars as pl
from pathlib import Path

s = pl.Series([Path(), Path("abc")])
print(s)
```


### Log output

```shell
thread '<unnamed>' panicked at crates/polars-core/src/fmt.rs:373:19:
Object("object", Some(object-registry)) not impl
note: run with `RUST_BACKTRACE=1` environment variable to display a backtrace
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/home/stijn/code/polars/py-polars/repro.py", line 10, in <module>
    print(s)
  File "/home/stijn/code/polars/py-polars/polars/series/series.py", line 629, in __str__
    s_repr: str = self._s.as_str()
                  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
pyo3_runtime.PanicException: Object("object", Some(object-registry)) not impl
```


### Issue description

Printing object columns works fine as part of a dataframe, but not for a Series.

### Expected behavior

Printing should work normally.

### Installed versions

main

review_comments: I am a little confused why non-none `registry` would block format here, Is there something I'm not aware of?
